item.title: Province urges continued water conservation, fall flood preparedness
item.description: Updated Sept. 21, 2026 Persistent drought means water-conserving efforts vital as communities prepare for seasonal storms

item.title: RSV vaccines available to seniors in B.C.
item.description: Seniors with the highest risk of serious illness from RSV will get free vaccine starting next week

item.title: Traffic-pattern changes on Highway 1 at Mount Lehman Road
item.description: Drivers are advised of westbound off-ramp closures on Highway 1 at Fraser Highway and Mount Lehman Road starting at 9 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 13, 2026.

item.title: People advised to plan for storm, possible flood conditions on South Coast highways
item.description: Drivers in the South Coast region, including the Lower Mainland, Sunshine Coast, Vancouver Island and Fraser Valley, are advised to prepare for winds, heavy rainfall and possible flooding through the region starting Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, and through the rest of the week.

item.title: Shelter spaces opening for people in need during winter weather
item.description: As of Nov. 1, 2026, the Province, through BC Housing, has 6,588 shelter spaces available for people in 63 communities throughout the province.

item.title: BC Coroners Service investigating 133 deaths from drug toxicity in September
item.description: According to preliminary data, 133 people died in September 2026 due to suspected unregulated drug toxicity, as reported by the BC Coroners Service.

item.title: BC Coroners Service announces inquest dates into death of Chase de Balinhard
item.description: A coroner’s inquest has been scheduled to examine the circumstances surrounding the death of Chase de Balinhard.

item.title: Ramp closures needed on Highway 1 at Mount Lehman Road
item.description: Beginning at 9 p.m. on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, the westbound Highway 1 off-ramps to Fraser Highway and Mount Lehman Road will be closed until 7 a.m. on Saturday, Oct. 24.

item.title: BC Coroners Service releases July, August drug-toxicity death findings
item.description: Preliminary reporting by the BC Coroners Service (BCCS) shows that 113 people died in July, and 126 people in August 2026, due to unregulated drug toxicity.

item.title: Allenby Road in Duncan closure extended till spring 2027
item.description: Drivers, residents and local businesses are advised that the closure on Allenby Road, from just past Boys Road to Miller Road in Duncan, has been extended until spring 2027.
